raw_encoded_tokens.definition: Direct BPE tokenizer encoding of entire text without windowing or padding.

tokens_counted_by_manifest.definition: Declared token_count in SPLIT_V2_MANIFEST.json and CORPUS_V2_CLEANED_MANIFEST.json.

chunked_target_tokens_static_eval.definition: Evaluation target tokens tiled at stride 255 with context 256 and 1-token causal shift.
chunked_target_tokens_static_eval.loss_per_chunk: 1 token loss per document/window transition due to autoregressive shift

training_processed_tokens.definition: Total tokens ingested by training loop: steps * grad_accum * batch_size * context_length.
training_processed_tokens.mechanism: Stochastic random window sampling with replacement from 782 train documents

interchangeability_warning: These 4 quantities measure fundamentally different stages of data processing and must NEVER be treated as interchangeable.
